_validation_note: All eight candidates failed the six-point attribution gate on re-verification. CANDIDATE A (drone cold battery, 11th Airborne / Breaking Defense) - Gate 5 fails: the only counter to the '10-minutes at -20F' claim is an unnamed EW technician in the same article; Quantum Systems' domain blocks WebFetch (HTTP 403), so no manufacturer spec, Army test report, or SAM.gov contract for the Vector's cold-weather endurance could be confirmed. Gate 1 also borderline (verbatim is journalist narration, not a named speaker's direct quote). CANDIDATE B (AI transformative for Arctic ISR, Ted Stevens Center / CEPA) - Gate 3 fails: generic thesis, not reducible to a specific Alaska AI decision or named actor. CANDIDATE D (Koniag ANC 8(a) streamlined procurement) - Gate 4 fails as true_as_stated: the ANC 8(a) sole-source mechanism is legally real and operative; the steelmanned claim is a correct legal description, not a falsifiable assertion. CANDIDATE E (Greensparc downward rate pressure) - Gate 2 fails: single executive statement, no second independent asserter; Gate 5 counter (Hagerman, Wrangell Sentinel) returned HTTP 403. CANDIDATE F (GenAI essential, Knipp/Alaska Communications) - Gate 5 fails: the MIT 'State of AI in Business 2025' primary report is not fetchable (all MIT URLs 404); only one secondary source cites the 95% zero-return statistic. CANDIDATE G (Begich connectivity is base requirement) - Gate 6 fails: materially overlaps the 6/13 already-corrected broadband-connectivity-as-AI-prerequisite claim. CANDIDATE H (Painter data centers few jobs) - Gate 1 fails: Alaska Beacon primary URL returns HTTP 403; the only other URL tested used a speculative/fabricated article ID that cannot be verified as a real live page. The structurally strongest candidate was H (load-bearing, rebuttable from ADN primaries) but it failed live-page verification; second-strongest was A but its counter-evidence could not clear the primary/two-independent-source bar. No claim was promoted past the gate. The gate is the column's whole point, so no post shipped this cycle.
